hero.name: Miguel Giles
hero.tagline: Electromechanic by Trade. Developer by Passion. Builder by Nature.

mechanic.title: The Mechanic
mechanic.description: For over 13 years, I kept complex industrial systems running — first in industrial refrigeration, then in GxP pharmaceutical plants. Every machine speaks a language, every failure has a pattern, and every solution has a logic. Problem-solving became my second nature.

spark.title: The Spark
spark.description: One day I discovered that the same logical thinking could create software. Programming wasn't new to me — it was the same problem-solving, but without physical limits. Vibe coding opened a door I never thought I'd walk through.

builder.title: The Builder
builder.description: Today I build applications that solve real problems. My industrial experience gave me something no bootcamp can teach: understanding complex systems from their roots. Every NEX app is born from a real need I identified and solved.

nexindu.description: Industrial operating system for GxP pharmaceutical plants. Work order management, preventive maintenance, spare parts inventory, and AI assistant with RAG memory.

nexkio.description: Complete management system for small stores. POS with hardware barcode scanner, offline-first inventory, store credit system, financial reports, and digital receipts with QR.

nexquipu.description: Family finance manager with AI. Analyzes credit card statements, detects subscriptions and hidden charges, and generates personalized financial recommendations.

nexwod.description: AI-powered workout tracker. Generates personalized routines, calculates per-muscle-group fatigue, automatically detects personal records, and offers smart coaching.

nexpulse.description: Poker tournament manager for home games. P2P remote control via WebRTC, synthesized audio engine, blind timer, and automatic prize pool calculation.

nexgrid.description: Smart price comparison tool. Paste any URL and automatically extract metadata. AI analyzes and recommends with scoring and pros/cons.

bbraun.description: Critical process management and maintenance in pharmaceutical production line. Daily troubleshooting application. Lean/5S mindset.

coiron.description: Team leadership in ground-up assembly projects. Full responsibility over complex installations.

recent.description: Self-taught since 2023. Since early 2025, 100% vibe coding — which radically scaled my app output. Building end-to-end solutions with Next.js, React, Python and AI-powered architectures.

I combine the rigor of industrial maintenance, process automation, and troubleshooting with web application development (Vibe Coding) to build robust software solutions that solve real-world problems.
